title: Objectwise augmentation quotient comparisons and their degree-zero value
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U_i$ an open cover, and $F$ one abelian sheaf [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Assume the explicit section augmentation [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction] is a quasi-isomorphism for every injective resolution of $F$. There exist additive maps $c_F^q:\check H^q(U,F)\to H^q(X,F)$ for all $q$, satisfying IsAbelianCechComparison on every resolution. Their degree-zero value is inverse of the canonical restriction isomorphism, followed by the inverse Ext-to-sections isomorphism. There is no assertion of naturality between different sheaves or of compatibility with connecting maps.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, construction of H(beta) H(alpha) inverse and independence of the resolution

proof.text: Fix an injective resolution. Using the supplied quasi-isomorphism hypothesis define the comparison as H(beta), inverse H(alpha), and inverse of the canonical Ext-to-section-complex identification. The constant-sheaf adjunction evaluated on 1 defines that identification termwise; extMk represents every Ext class.

Compare with another injective resolution by lifting the identity. The alpha/beta squares and Ext cocycle computation commute with the lift. Its section map and total map induce homology isomorphisms. Cancel the total map to prove the augmentation quotient characterization for every resolution.
In degree zero alpha and beta send sections to the same restriction family in the (0,0) summand. Cancel their canonical cohomology identifications to obtain the normalized gluing formula.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_abelianCechComparison_maps
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (hα : ∀ I : InjectiveResolution F, QuasiIso (abelianCechAlpha U I)) :
    ∃ c : ∀ q, (TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyFunctor U q).obj F ⟶
      (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) q).obj F,
      (∀ q, IsAbelianCechComparison U F q (c q)) ∧
      c 0 = (TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyZeroIso U hcover).inv.app F ≫
        (Sheaf.functorHZeroIso (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) isTerminalTop).inv.app F
